nodes.question: How do sensor-enabled lighting technologies in smart cities impact health and well-being?
nodes.answer: Sensor-enabled lighting technologies in smart cities are argued to enhance good health and well-being, especially concerning psychological effects associated with visual and non-visual perception. This includes benefits related to safety and reduced road injuries. However, what negative impact on animals' lives do Both and Caldwell warn about in relation to artificial lighting?
